tangential and in an elevated mood. No signs of organic syndromes were found, consequently, lab        Commented [mg5]: ;

arranged who gave him and diazepam was given under their supervision.

On the next day, the tests ruled out any organic pathology; additionally, the Mental Health team
confirmed the diagnosis of non-organic mania and ruled out harm to self or others. Nevertheless,       Commented [mg6]: Avoid academic connectors ->
he was still tangential, therefore, he was prescribed quetiapine. Today his uncle mentioned that he    however

might not have been taking the medication.                                                             Commented [mg7]: had - > use past with reported

In light of the above, I would be grateful if you would manage his condition as you see appropriate.   Commented [mg8]: could
Kindly note that he speaks very basic English and might need a referral to a Chinese speaking
psychiatrist in the future.

Yours faithfully,
Doctor
